description: A delayed raise is a timer of the run, from the sequence `after` timers take their ids from. `Start` schedules `Remind` 1 for 1 s as it leaves `Idle`; it fires in `Waiting`, whose own `after 3s` is restarted each time `Remind` re-enters it. `Confirm` finishes the run: its states are exited, then the pending `reminder` is cancelled with `raise.cancelled`.
